structure: CSharp emits mapped-file primitives before runtime helpers complete. Dynamic SourceText destruction checks null ownership, heap-owned sentinel and mapped memory. SLG SourceText drop helper calls runtime_unmap_text but platform helpers depend only on direct reachable SourceText IR; owned aggregate drop closure can require SourceText with no direct node.
branches: Compare activeSemanticDropTypes transitive closure to emitted SourceText drop helpers; preserve pointer width, target platform, borrowed/heap/mapped ownership and declaration de-duplication. Do not add a declaration-only stub or suppress the drop.
verification: CSharp3/3 before edits. First run the existing Native on the same small cases to reproduce undefined runtime dependencies without rerunning original1999.
implementation: Reuse the existing implicit-drop runtime admission pattern already used for Process and File: include SourceText when the exact emitted drop closure contains builtin kind1/origin1/symbol24. Both platform bodies and core preamble consume the same predicate. No broad declared-type admission, empty stub, drop suppression, source or oracle change.
